versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃

controles.web: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
controles.kjv: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
controles.livre: Certamente há minas para a prata, e o ouro lugar onde o derretem.

versos.hebraico: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
controles.kjv: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
controles.livre: O ferro é tirado do solo, e da pedra se funde o cobre.

versos.hebraico: קֵ֤ץ׀ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל־תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
controles.kjv: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
controles.livre: O homem põe fim às trevas, e investiga em toda extremidade, as pedras que estão na escuridão e nas mais sombrias trevas.

versos.hebraico: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל׀ מֵֽעִם־גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי־רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ׃

controles.web: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
controles.kjv: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
controles.livre: Abre um poço onde não há morador, lugares esquecidos por quem passa a pé; pendurados longe da humanidade, vão de um lado para o outro.

versos.hebraico: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא־לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ־אֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
controles.kjv: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
controles.livre: Da terra o pão procede, e por debaixo ela é transformada como que pelo fogo.

versos.hebraico: מְקוֹם־סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
controles.kjv: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
controles.livre: Suas pedras são o lugar da safira, e contém pó de ouro.

versos.hebraico: נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא־יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה׃

controles.web: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
controles.kjv: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:
controles.livre: A ave de rapina não conhece essa vereda; os olhos do falcão  não a viram.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי־שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא־עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל׃

controles.web: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
controles.kjv: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
controles.livre: Os filhotes de animais ferozes nunca a pisaram, nem o feroz leão passou por ela.

versos.hebraico: בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃

controles.web: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
controles.kjv: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
controles.livre: O homem põe sua mão no rochedo, e revolve os montes desde a raiz.

versos.hebraico: בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל־יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
controles.kjv: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
controles.livre: Cortou canais pelas rochas, e seus olhos veem tudo o que é precioso.

versos.hebraico: מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר׃פ

controles.web: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
controles.kjv: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
controles.livre: Ele tapa os rios desde suas nascentes, e faz o oculto sair para a luz.

versos.hebraico: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃

controles.web: “But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
controles.kjv: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
controles.livre: Porém onde se achará a sabedoria? E onde está o lugar da inteligência?

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃

controles.web: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
controles.kjv: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
controles.livre: O ser humano não conhece o valor dela, nem ela é achada na terra dos viventes.

versos.hebraico: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי־הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃

controles.web: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
controles.kjv: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
controles.livre: O abismo diz: Não está em mim; E o mar diz: Nem comigo.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃

controles.web: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.
controles.kjv: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
controles.livre: Nem por ouro fino se pode comprar, nem se pesar em troca de prata.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר׃

controles.web: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
controles.kjv: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
controles.livre: Não pode ser avaliada com ouro de Ofir, nem com ônix precioso, nem com safira.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי־פָֽז׃

controles.web: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
controles.kjv: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
controles.livre: Não se pode comparar com ela o ouro, nem o cristal; nem se pode trocar por joia de ouro fino.

versos.hebraico: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃

controles.web: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
controles.kjv: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
controles.livre: De coral nem de quartzo não se fará menção; porque o preço da sabedoria é melhor que o de rubis.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃פ

controles.web: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
controles.kjv: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
controles.livre: O topázio de Cuxe não se pode comparar com ela; nem pode ser avaliada com o puro ouro fino.

versos.hebraico: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃

controles.web: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
controles.kjv: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
controles.livre: De onde, pois, vem a sabedoria? E onde está o lugar da inteligência?

versos.hebraico: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל־חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃

controles.web: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
controles.kjv: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
controles.livre: Porque encoberta está aos olhos de todo vivente, e é oculta a toda ave do céu.

versos.hebraico: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
controles.kjv: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
controles.livre: O perdição e a morte dizem: Com nossos ouvidos ouvimos sua fama.

versos.hebraico: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת־מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃

controles.web: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
controles.kjv: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
controles.livre: Deus entende o caminho dela, e ele conhece seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת־הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
controles.kjv: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
controles.livre: Porque ele enxerga até os confins da terra, e vê tudo o que há debaixo de céus.

versos.hebraico: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃

controles.web: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
controles.kjv: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
controles.livre: Quando ele deu peso ao vento, e estabeleceu medida para as águas;

versos.hebraico: בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃

controles.web: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;
controles.kjv: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
controles.livre: Quando ele fez lei para a chuva, e caminho para o relâmpago dos trovões,

versos.hebraico: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָֽהּ׃

controles.web: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
controles.kjv: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
controles.livre: Então ele a viu, e relatou; preparou-a, e também a examinou.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר׀ לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃ס

controles.web: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
controles.kjv: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
controles.livre: E disse ao homem: Eis que o temor ao Senhor é a sabedoria, e o desviar-se do mal é a inteligência.
